description: Implement the `sys` native module providing system constants and limited functions: maxsize (int constant), platform (str constant), version (str constant), byteorder (str constant), getrecursionlimit() -> int, exit(code) -> None. Constants use the ConstantSymbol interface.
steps: Create directory sysmod/ (Go package name `sysmod` to avoid Go's `sys` package conflict) with sysmod.go containing const Name = "sys" and func New() *module.NativeModule.

Implement constant symbols (maxsize, platform, version, byteorder) using module.NewConstant: maxsize with types.Int emitting I64_CONST math.MaxInt64; platform with types.Str emitting the string constant based on runtime.GOOS; version with types.Str emitting a minipy version string; byteorder with types.Str emitting 'little'.
Implement getrecursionlimit() - 0 args, returns int (emit I64_CONST 1000 as a fixed value).
Implement exit(code) - 1 int arg (or Any), returns None. Emits a TRAP instruction to halt the VM.
Create sysmod/sysmod_test.go testing New() returns expected symbols and constant types.
Register sys in compiler/module.go defaultRegistry() with import of sysmod package.

Add compiler integration tests in compiler/sys_test.go: `import sys\nprint(str(sys.maxsize))` outputs 9223372036854775807, `print(sys.platform)` outputs a platform string, `print(str(sys.getrecursionlimit()))` outputs 1000.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./compiler passes with sys integration tests
